name: Henday / Calgary Trail / Gateway Boulevard and Blackmud Creek arches
centre_note: Midpoint of the two OSM deck centres. H27 (Henday / Calgary Trail / Gateway Boulevard) is 53.437, -113.491. H28 (Blackmud Creek arches) is 53.437, -113.496. Both from bridge-geometry.json, centre field, not estimated.
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal WGS84 length along the OSM nodes (spherical haversine), one decimal. A plan length is not a structural length. An approach plan length is not the climb to grade. Ways clipped by the download box are marked in 'which'.
dropped_note: Dropped as a different code or outside the structure: (a) the W88 Whitemud / Calgary Trail object (53.4804, -113.4938) and its Calgary Trail NW and Gateway Boulevard NW bridge ways, about 4.5 km north; (b) H29 approach way 25477516 (Henday at 111 Street), west of the Blackmud arches. Cross-road ways (Calgary Trail, Gateway Boulevard, Whitemud Drive and ring ramps passing under or over the deck) are kept only as the cross_roads list, not as decks or approaches. Three ways appear on both the H27 and H28 objects (41985724, 186995537, 22927691); each is placed once, under H27.

Two-lane ramp tagged as a bridge at layer 2, running north to south across the Henday alignment, destination 2 South. CCE 2008 calls the third Blackmud structure a ramp from the Calgary Trail interchange; this way is the best candidate, not confirmed. Plan length 316.4 m is far longer than the 76 m CCE figure per structure.

H28_structure_length_m_each.source: Canadian Consulting Engineer, 'Three Crossings On Henday' (2008). Each of the three Blackmud Creek structures.

H28_embankment_height_each_side_m.source: CCE 2008 (arch thrust partly supports 16 m embankments)

H28_deck_slab_depth_m.source: CCE 2008 (1.5 m cellular slab, five cells per bridge, cantilevered top slab up to 4 m out from the main girders)

H27_trellis_span_m.source: CCE 2008 (chosen over a minimum of about 22 m)

H27_trellis_beam_width_mm.value: 600 at bottom, 1000 at underside of top flange; flange width 1300

H27_trellis_skew_deg.value: 50 to 80 on two structures, south to north

H27_supports.value: integral abutments; no piers next to the roadway

osm_added_2026_11_23.note: All motorway, motorway_link, secondary road, stream and railway ways in the box 53.4285..53.4420, -113.5215..-113.4800, read from the OSM API (api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map) on 2026-11-23 for the model. Nodes outside the box are dropped (clipped=true). The Blackmud Creek arches are Henday ways 25477513 (westbound) and 25477514 (eastbound) and ramp 25477544 + 115754686 at 53.4348, -113.5134, where stream 490629227 crosses; the ways at -113.496 first listed as H28 are the H27 trellis flyovers over ramp 22915670.
